# Cryp-Cross

> Cryp-Cross is a crypto crossword challenge concept: a fresh crossword every day, correct answers recorded on a verifiable ledger, and blockchain-based token rewards that players can trade. This site presents the concept.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Introduction to Cryp-Cross
- [The Idea](/idea): Problem statement, key features and blockchain integration
- [Team](/team): The people building Cryp-Cross

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Jevoel16/Cryp-Cross): Source code (MERN: React, Express, MongoDB), licensed under the Sprucetrap Source-Available License 1.0
